title: Azon Dominator releases through 2024-06-03 contain an SQL injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated…
description: Azon Dominator versions released through June 3, 2024, contain an SQL injection vulnerability in the /fetch_products.php endpoint via the cid parameter. This flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to manipulate database queries using crafted POST requests with boolean-based or time-based blind SQL injection payloads. The vulnerability was publicly observed being exploited as of July 30, 2024. It has a high severity with a CVSS score of 8.2.
